commits.patch:
diff --git a/lib/mprintf.c b/lib/mprintf.c
index abe0df4..df292da 100644
--- a/lib/mprintf.c
+++ b/lib/mprintf.c
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
 #define BUFFSIZE 326 /* buffer for long-to-str and float-to-str calcs, should
                         fit negative DBL_MAX (317 letters) */
 #define MAX_PARAMETERS 128 /* number of input arguments */
-#define MAX_SEGMENTS   128 /* number of output segments */
+#define MAX_SEGMENTS   256 /* number of output segments */
 
 /* Lower-case digits. */
 const unsigned char Curl_ldigits[] = "0123456789abcdef";

coupling: The earlier mprintf commit permits up to 256 output segments while leaving the 128-entry argument array and its bitmap bounded by MAX_PARAMETERS. This is safe by itself because the argument-index check still uses MAX_PARAMETERS. The later error-handling commit changes the conversion argument check to MAX_SEGMENTS; in the unedited batch those caps are both 128, so this change alone is safe. Together, a 129-conversion format passes the segment and argument checks, then writes input[128] past the stack array. Preserving support for the longer format requires keeping the segment and argument capacities independent at every argument use, including the argument bitmap; merely reviewing either local maintenance change without the other misses the mismatched bounds.
